abstract: Data and analysis code for a user study (N=200) examining how explanation correctness (of explainable AI outputs) at four levels (100%, 85%, 70%, 55%) affects human understanding in a time series classification task.

ur.tldr: 可解释AI(XAI)用户研究的补充材料。原始研究招募200名被试，在时间序列分类任务中操纵解释正确性为四个水平（100%、85%、70%、55%），考察不同正确度下计算XAI评估与人类理解之间的关联，旨在桥接算法评估与人类认知。

title: Data and analysis code for: Does Explanation Correctness Matter? Linking Computational XAI Evaluation to Human Understanding
title_zh: 数据与分析代码：解释正确性是否重要？连接计算XAI评估与人类理解
